name: Psi
source:
In post-catastrophe New Paris, society is divided between the “pure” and the second-rate. Lou, a telekinetic girl from the slums, joins the Church-run psionic force, Assistant Corps, chasing the truth: is humanity determined by blood – or something more?

[From [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/%CE%A8_Psi]romance-club.fandom[/url]]
